title: 合成示例：bulk RNA 治疗反应复现任务

sources.citation: SYNTHETIC DEMO. Not a real publication or biological finding.
sources.text: Synthetic example only. A fictional paired bulk RNA study compared pretreatment and post-treatment samples from the same donors. The authors reported reduced interferon-response activity after treatment, while the magnitude varied across donors. They used within-donor contrasts and gene-set analysis. This association does not establish a treatment mechanism. The example supplies no measured effect size or significance value.
